newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bourse suspends trade in Riviera.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bourse suspends trade in Riviera.

text.p: The Swiss stock exchange said it had suspended trade in securities of Riviera Participations Holding SA, based in Vevey, Switzerland, due to a request from the company.
The suspension will last until the end of trade at 1530 GMT.

"The company will announce important news during this afternoon which might have a substantial impact on the securities of the aforementioned company," the stock exchange said in a statement. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
